datasets.name: OracleDataSet2

select  f.name,sum(round(h.rest*o.ostat,2)) portfel ,sum(round(cm_coefficient.get_odenilmelirest(p.id,:dat)*o.ostat,2)) odenilmeli ,
sum(round(cm_coefficient.get_paymain(p.id,:dat)*o.ostat,2)) odenilmish,
sum(round(cm_coefficient.get_paymain(p.id,:dat)*o.ostat,2))-sum(round(cm_coefficient.get_odenilmelirest(p.id,:dat)*o.ostat,2)) artiq
,sum(round(cm_coefficient.get_gecmain(p.id,:dat)*o.ostat,2)) gec

cm_history h,
sb_filial f,
smart.OPERKURS o
where 
p.id=h.creditid and 
h.hdate = :dat and
p.branchid=f.id and
o.dat = :dat and
p.currency=o.VAL_KOD  --and h.rest>0
